description: Seismic Surveys Offshore Malta is a dataset listed in EGDI Metadata Catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by continentalshelf.gov.mt. This dataset contains information on the location of seismic surveys acquired offshore Malta. Coverage: Europe. The listing shows 2026-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://services.cuzk.gov.cz/registry/codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/authorizedUsers). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geology-cz.
